definition: The smallest set of a plan's declared facts that cannot all hold at once, named by the solver when it proves the plan cannot be placed as declared. It is found for a plan on the bench, never for a brief.
basis: Our wording of the refusal the solver gives. VISION.md: the system "should be able to return a named conflict set"; docs/geometry.md: "The footprint grows a bay before any requirement is blamed.", and for five rooms all doored to one another "the conflict set names the door pairs".
